entities.name: LADN Information
entities.description: Consists of LADN DNNs and LADN service area information (a set of tracking areas). Received during registration or generic UE configuration update procedures.

entities.name: LADN DNN
entities.description: Data Network Name identifying a Local Area Data Network.

entities.name: LADN Service Area
entities.description: Set of tracking areas where LADN services are available. UE determines location inside/outside based on this information.

entities.name: UE located inside LADN service area
entities.description: Condition when UE is within the LADN service area based on LADN service area information.

entities.name: UE located outside LADN service area
entities.description: Condition when UE is outside the LADN service area or lacks LADN service area information.

entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE
entities.description: 5GMM substate where UE has normal network service availability.

entities.name: UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to establish a PDU session for LADN.

entities.name: UE-requested PDU session modification procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to modify a PDU session for LADN.

entities.name: Service request procedure
entities.description: Procedure to re-establish user-plane resources for PDU session for LADN.

entities.name: UE-requested PDU session release procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to release a PDU session for LADN.

entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: 5GMM state where UE is not registered with the network.

relations.description: LADN information contains LADN service area information.
UE inside LADN service area condition allows PDU session establishment.
UE inside LADN service area condition allows PDU session modification.
UE inside LADN service area condition allows service request procedure.
UE outside LADN service area condition allows PDU session release.
UE outside LADN service area condition allows PDU session modification for 3GPP PS data off status change.
PDU session establishment for LADN requires UE to be in 5GMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE state.
Transition to 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state causes UE to delete stored LADN information.
